end_warm_room.title: THE WARM ROOM
end_warm_room.body: The census board covers a wall of the turbine hall. Names in chalk, more every week. The lamp line burns every night. No one is coming. There is a plan for this winter, and a draft for the next.

end_ledger.title: THE LEDGER
end_ledger.body: The list has 412 names. In December the valley had thirty thousand. It is honest now. You keep the turbines. You have a pencil with an eraser. You use the eraser.

end_stillwater.title: STILLWATER
end_stillwater.body: The turbines go east on hay sleds to the Stillwater field. Your father meets the first sled. From the canyon you watch Reno go dark, one window at a time.

end_dark_water.title: DARK WATER
end_dark_water.body: The wellheads scream, then go quiet. Nobody will kill for this place again. The valley goes cold, the tall ones go still, and you walk south with everyone who trusts you.

end_two_coats.title: TWO COATS
end_two_coats.body: You slip out before dawn with two packs and two coats. Nobody stops you. Nobody notices.
